name: Person
description: A human being known to the user — themself, family, friends, colleagues, contacts.

attributes.name: aliases
attributes.description: Alternative names/nicknames used to refer to this person.

attributes.name: relationship
attributes.description: What they are to the user — friend, colleague, recruiter, former manager.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: What they do where they work.

attributes.name: assistant
attributes.description: The assistant that looks after this person's world, if they have one.

methods.name: send_email
methods.description: Send an email to this person's `email`. Requires `email` to be set.

methods.name: add_fact
methods.signature: add_fact(predicate: str, value: str, confidence: float = 1.0) -> Preference
methods.description: Record a Preference/Fact instance about this person and link it via `subject`.

methods.name: research
methods.description: Ground/enrich this person's attributes via live search (Tavily) when little is known about them.
